title: Spark: Hero Tactics FAQ
body:
Want to master Spark: Hero Tactics, Discord's strategic PvP card battle game? Learn how to build powerful decks, deploy units effectively, and dominate the battlefield in this tactical card-based combat game.

What is Spark: Hero Tactics?

Spark: Hero Tactics is an Activity developed by Discord. Compete in fast-paced card battles on a 3x4 grid with players from around the globe. Cast creatures, constructs, and powerful spells to smash enemy fortresses. Craft your deck, upgrade unique heroes, and unlock their ultimate powers. Compete in seasonal challenges, earn rewards, and rise in the ranks. With endless quests and evolving strategies, every match is a new adventure!

How to Start Spark: Hero Tactics

Spark: Hero Tactics is available on the Discord desktop app, iOS and Android mobile apps, and browser app. There are many different ways you can launch Spark: Hero Tactics in Discord for you and your friends! Whether in a server’s voice channel, in a direct message (DM), or a group message, you can check out How to Use Apps for instructions on how to start any Activity.

NOTE: To optimize Activity performance, enable Hardware Acceleration in User Settings > Advanced before launching any Discord Activity.

How To Play Spark: Hero Tactics

Example of Spark: Hero Tactics Gameplay

The Basics

Spend Spark, a magical resource, to cast Creatures and Spells in fast paced battles on a grid-based board. Use your Hero’s Ultimate for powerful effects! The fortress you are defending, and the one you are attacking have different Health and Damage stats depending on the Hero chosen. Demolish your opponent’s Fortress, and defend your own to win!

Building a Deck

Select a Hero, each with unique and powerful Ultimates. Then select 15 Creatures, Spells or Construct cards to add to your deck. You can have up to 3 copies of the same card in a deck.

Battling, Spark & Cards

In battle, Spark generates and is used to cast Creature or Spell cards. Each Creature and Spell has a different Spark cost. 

Cast Creature cards on your Fortress to summon them. Friendly and opponent creatures will move and attack on their own. Creatures have their own Health and Attack stats, which can be boosted when combined with Spells, Heroes, Ultimates, and other cards on the board.

Spells have different Spark costs, and require a target to use (friendly or foe). Spells have one-time effects on targets, such as increasing or reducing Health or Attack stats, boosting creature speed, and much more.

Strategize with different combinations of Heroes, Creatures, and Spells to battle your way across the board, defend your Fortress, and bring the enemy Fortress to zero heath to win! For more information, check the How To section inside the game’s settings menu, and see Game Terminology below.

Leveling Up

Here's how you can grow stronger and dominate the battlefield:

  • Player XP: Battle to earn XP and Power! Win matches to gain Power and increase your Rank. At the end of each season, claim rewards based on your achieved Rank. As you level up, unlock rewards such as card packs, copper, and gold.
  • Discover New Locations: With each level gained, you’ll unlock new Locations, discovering more powerful cards and facing formidable opponents. 
  • Hero XP: Earn Hero XP through battles. As your Heroes level up, you’ll earn cosmetic upgrades, stat increases, ability upgrades, and valuable resources! 
  • Level Up Cards: Level up your cards to earn cosmetic upgrades and resources. Use resources to expand your card collection, unlock new Heroes, or power  up your existing ones!

The more you play, the stronger you become. So gear up, strategize, and conquer the Spark universe!

Battle Modes

Game Mode selection in Spark: Hero Tactics

Spark: Hero Tactics offers three distinct battle modes:

Mode Description How to Access Rewards
Competitive Match with opponents across all Discord servers with similar level and rank Press PLAY on the Home Screen or select Competitive in the Battle tab Increase Power, earn Ranks, gain Player XP and Hero XP, progress on Quests
Friendly Private matches with players in the same server and channel you’re currently playing in Both players select Friendly from the Battle tab in the same channel  Earn Player and Hero XP, progress on Quests 
Practice Battles against in-game bots Select Practice in the Battle tab None

Store and In-App Purchases

Spark: Hero Tactics is still in development and in early access, with content, availability, and pricing subject to change.
In-app purchases are available on desktop only, but usable in the Activity across all platforms where your account is logged in. For instance, gold purchased on desktop can be utilized on mobile to buy Creature cards, Spell cards, and Card Packs.

Store offerings

Daily Deals offered in the store are randomly generated and may vary for each user daily. Check back regularly for a chance to purchase that special card you’ve been eyeing!

Content currently available for in-app purchase:

  • Starter Packs including Card Packs and Gold (limit of 1 per user)
  • Daily Deals:
    • Free Daily Gold (claim it once per day, every day!)
    • 4 individual Creature and Spell Cards (refreshed daily)
  • Card Packs (see below for more details):
    • “Minor” Card Pack containing 4 mystery cards of lower rarity cards than the Spark Pack
    • “Spark” Card Pack containing 4 mystery cards of higher rarity cards than the Minor Pack
  • Gold and Copper – Offerings subject to change
    • Gold in quantities ranging from 400 - 9,450
    • Copper in quantities ranging from 1,000 to 40,000

Card Packs

Comparison of Minor Card Pack (left) and Spark Card Pack (right) in Spark: Hero Tactics

NOTE: You won’t know the contents of a Card Pack until you’ve purchased and opened it. This also applies to Card Packs earned through gameplay.

The chances of obtaining cards of different rarities is as follows:

  • Minor Pack: This pack contains more common cards than the Spark Pack.

Minor Card Pack: Drop Rates and Contents Overview in Spark: Hero Tactics

  • Spark Pack: This pack contains more rare cards than the Minor Pack.

Spark Card Pack: Drop Rates and Contents Overview in Spark: Hero Tactics

To check a card’s rarity in the Collections tab
1. Press the Sort Options icon and sort by Rarity.

Collections Menu: Organizing and Sorting Card Options in Spark: Hero Tactics

 2. Select a card. The Description will show, and the card’s border color indications its rarity: 
Gray = Common
Blue = Rare
Purple = Epic
Yellow = Legendary
Orange = Apex

Game Terminology

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is there an age requirement?

A: There is currently no specific age requirement for Spark: Hero Tactics beyond the general age requirements for using Discord’s services, as described in our Terms of Service. This includes our Paid Services Terms, which apply to any purchases you make through Discord. Accordingly, if you are under 18 (or the legal age of majority in your place of residence), you need your parent’s or guardian’s permission to make in-app purchases.

Q: How do I anonymize my display name and avatar in Spark: Hero Tactics

A: After completing the tutorial, your first Competitive battle will prompt you to choose how you’d like to be displayed in-game. Select the Anonymize option to receive a random avatar and display name. If you do not select the Anonymize option, your display name and avatar from your Discord User Profile settings will be shown. You can adjust this setting at any time in the Activity’s Settings menu.

NOTE: Friendly mode doesn't offer anonymization since you will be playing with people in the same space you’re using the Activity. In this mode, your display name will be your Discord display name, and your avatar will either be your Discord avatar or the one you’ve set within Spark: Hero Tactics.

Q: If I make purchases in Spark: Hero Tactics on one server, will they be available when I play Spark: Hero Tactics on different servers?

A: Yes, purchases you make in Spark: Hero Tactics are tied to your Discord account for use in the Activity wherever you play it. This means any items you buy while playing on one server will be available to use when you play on any other server with the same Discord account. 

Q: Can I trade my cards in, or trade them with a friend?

A: No, trading or transferring is not available.

Q: I bought something in the Activity, can I get a refund?

A: We do not offer refunds for the items that can be purchased currently since they are one-time purchases, as described in our Refund Policy.

Q: Where can I give feedback or report bugs and problems with the game?

A: There are a few ways to report bugs or provide feedback. Join the Spark Hero Tactics Community Discord Server, or submit a bug report for this  or any other Activity by going to https://dis.gd/bugreport.

For detailed instructions on submitting bug reports, please refer to our Help Center article: https://dis.gd/bugs.  

Q: How do I view or delete my data for Spark: Hero Tactics? What data is tracked?

A: As with other Discord services, you can view and delete data for Discord-developed Activities like Spark: Hero Tactics through the Discord Privacy and Safety settings and our Privacy Policy applies. You can also view the permissions you authorized for the Activity under Authorized Apps in your Discord User Settings.

NOTE: Deleting your data will remove all of your progression maintained by any Discord-developed Activities.

Q: My question isn't listed, what do I do?

A: If all is lost, please submit a ticket to our support team at https://dis.gd/contact
